title: Repeated Read Coils with varied units and address ranges
purpose: Exercise repeated Read Coils transactions across different unit identifiers and address ranges while preserving the issue-supported relation that repeated operations may behave differently after an initially normal call.

messages.label: initial Read Coils request, unit ff, address 0, quantity 9
repeated Read Coils request, unit 7c, address 16, quantity 16
follow-up Read Coils request, unit 01, address 240, quantity 1

expected_behavior: Each request is a syntactically complete Read Coils transaction; a conforming server should parse the three requests independently and return a normal response or a protocol-level exception for an unsupported unit or address.
constraints_preserved: Each MBAP length is 0006, matching one unit byte plus the five-byte Read Coils PDU.
All quantities are positive and within the conventional Read Coils range.
Hex is lowercase and contains no separators.
issue_safety_notes: This is a valid structural analogue of repeated operations and unit/address variation. It does not copy the reported response bytes or intentionally create an inconsistent length, malformed PDU, or known crash payload.
